# Ballarat Granny Flat Builders

Ballarat Granny Flat Builders (https://ballaratgrannyflats.com.au/) is a free referral and quote service for people who want granny flat work in Ballarat, Victoria, Australia. It does not build granny flats itself. Enquiries from the quote form are passed to one local granny flat builder who services the customer's area, and that business contacts the customer directly.

## Important facts
- No phone number is published on the site.
- The site does not publish its own prices, reviews or ranking claims. Cost guides cite named public sources.
- Rules pages summarise official VIC government and council sources, with links.
- Contact for enquiries and privacy requests: quotes@ballaratgrannyflats.com.au.
